  This is a delivery only outlet which is spread across different cities in India.

The hot Biryani ,the aromatic Fragrance coming out of the Box can't be described in words, you need to order it to know the real taste of Royal Biryani.

A must try place in Bangalore for Biryani.
Would Love to Visit or Order again.
